_comment: Phase F pure-data exercise registry. See docs/08_exercise_config.md for the full schema, evidence for `type`, and the fill-in-the-blanks threshold table for the owner. Every `value: null` field below is an unfilled clinical placeholder — do NOT treat null as 0 or skip it in a real comparison.

heel_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = heel rising off the support surface
heel_lifting_max_y_rise.alert: Heel lifting off the surface — keep it down

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the support surface
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.alert: Hip lifting off the surface — keep it flat

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

slide_insufficient_min_heel_travel_ratio.unit: fraction of the rest hip->heel pixel distance
slide_insufficient_min_heel_travel_ratio.source: geometry of depth_target: with thigh ~= shin, knee 90 deg puts the heel at 0.71 of the straight-leg hip->heel distance (travel 0.29); 0.25 leaves slack. Provisional, NOT clinician-signed (2026-09-24)
slide_insufficient_min_heel_travel_ratio.alert: Slide your heel further toward your hip

slide_insufficient_return_deg.source: provisional live tuning (2026-09-24): slide_insufficient judges once the knee has straightened this far back from its lowest point

joints._note: use_3d was true, making the SIDE driver a 3D angle while the FRONT driver is 2D -- two rep drivers on different scales sharing one enter/exit pair. 3D standing knee angle straddles 127-172 (parquet p5/med), so enter=160 and exit=170 both sat inside the standing band and a stationary patient counted reps. Both drivers are now 2D, matching squat, whose joints are use_3d:false in both views for the same reason.

enter_angle.source: measured from backend/ml/manifest_data/train_mini_squat.parquet: left_knee_angle_2d standing max p5=176.1/med=179.6, bottom min med=81.4. Replaces docs/08's 160/170, which were read off the 3D standing median (172.0) while the FRONT driver is 2D. NOT clinician-signed.

exit_angle.source: measured from backend/ml/manifest_data/train_mini_squat.parquet: left_knee_angle_2d standing max p5=176.1/med=179.6, bottom min med=81.4. Replaces docs/08's 160/170, which were read off the 3D standing median (172.0) while the FRONT driver is 2D. NOT clinician-signed.

heel_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = heel rising off the floor

knee_past_toes_max_margin.alert: Knee past toes — sit back more

ankles_min_width_ratio.sign_convention: below threshold = ankles too close together
ankles_min_width_ratio.alert: Feet too close together — widen your stance

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

knee_varus_max_offset_ratio.unit: ratio (perpendicular knee offset from the hip->ankle line / hip width, FRONT view)
knee_varus_max_offset_ratio.sign_convention: above threshold = knee deviates laterally from the hip-ankle line (varus or valgus; unsigned)
knee_varus_max_offset_ratio.source: derived from manifest-labelled mini_squat clips: 83% of knee_varus clips caught at 6% false-positive on clean clips (n=6/16 after the ankle-width guard). Replaces knee_varus_max_angle_deg=10, which measured knee FLEXION and fired on 38/38 clean clips. NOT clinician-signed.
knee_varus_max_offset_ratio.alert: Knees bowing out — track knees over toes

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.unit: normalized y (pelvis_center_y vs the extractor's own whole-file 'baseline' column)
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the seat
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.alert: Hip lifting off the seat — stay seated

back_rocking_max_score.unit: same units as the extractor's own whole-file 'rocking_score' column (std-dev of head x-position)

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

back_slouching_max_head_forward_ratio.unit: ratio (|nose x - shoulder-centre x| / trunk length, image plane)
back_slouching_max_head_forward_ratio.sign_convention: above threshold = head carried forward of the shoulders (slouching)
back_slouching_max_head_forward_ratio.source: derived from manifest-labelled seated_knee_extension clips: 5/5 back_slouching clips caught, 0/17 false positives on clean clips. Replaces back_slouching_min_trunk_angle_deg=150, which fired on 100% of clips and had an inverted sign for this exercise. NOT clinician-signed.

hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg.unit: deg, raise angle = 180 - hip_angle_2d at peak-raise frame
hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg.sign_convention: above threshold = excessive hip flexion / compensation, labeled hip_lifting in this dataset
hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg.alert: Raising too high — lower the leg

knee_flexion_high_min_angle_deg.sign_convention: below threshold = knee bending too much during the raise (should stay near full extension)
knee_flexion_high_min_angle_deg.alert: Knee bending — keep your leg straight

head_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = head rising off the surface
head_lifting_max_y_rise.alert: Head lifting — rest your head down

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

enter_angle.source: derived from clinician start/end positions (supine, pillow under knee: knee 40 deg -> 0 deg flexion = 140 -> 180 deg); enter/exit sit above the ~140 deg rest with a 10 deg hysteresis band. Provisional (2026-09-24)

exit_angle.source: derived from clinician start/end positions (supine, pillow under knee: knee 40 deg -> 0 deg flexion = 140 -> 180 deg); enter/exit sit above the ~140 deg rest with a 10 deg hysteresis band. Provisional (2026-09-24)

depth_target.source: derived from clinician start/end positions (supine, pillow under knee: knee 40 deg -> 0 deg flexion = 140 -> 180 deg); enter/exit sit above the ~140 deg rest with a 10 deg hysteresis band. Provisional (2026-09-24)

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.unit: normalized y (pelvis_center_y vs the extractor's own whole-file 'avg_pelvis_center_y' column)
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the support surface
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.alert: Hip lifting — keep your hip down

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

thigh_lifting_max_hip_change_deg.unit: deg (left shoulder-hip-knee 2D angle, relative to its value when the rep starts)
thigh_lifting_max_hip_change_deg.source: clinician note: hip stays at 40 deg flexion during TKE; +-20 deg owner-set tolerance for pillow/support variation. Provisional (2026-09-24)
thigh_lifting_max_hip_change_deg.alert: Keep your thigh on the pillow — only straighten the knee

exercises.name: squat
exercises._note: Restored from the legacy physio project per owner instruction and MASTER_BUILD_PLAN_v3 §F1/§G2. Unlike the five ML-dataset exercises, every value here is REAL — transcribed from backend/_old_physio_reference/config.py, documented in docs/03_legacy.md D5. Not a placeholder.

knee_cave_min_width_ratio.alert: Knees caving in — push knees out

torso_lean_max_deg.signal: torso lean from vertical (shoulder-hip vs vertical)
torso_lean_max_deg.alert: Leaning too far forward — chest up

knee_past_toes_max_x_ratio.alert: Knee past toes — sit back more

butt_wink_min_hip_angle_deg.alert: Lower back rounding — brace your core

butt_wink_max_knee_angle_deg.signal: knee angle gate — butt wink only checked when knee is at least this bent

neck_min_angle_deg.alert: Neck not neutral — look straight ahead

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target

_validation_warning: UNVALIDATED THRESHOLDS. Every value in the five ML-dataset exercises (heel_slide, mini_squat, seated_knee_extension, straight_leg_raise, terminal_knee_extension) is dataset-derived from docs/08_exercise_config.md and has NOT been reviewed or signed off by a clinician. A flag raised on these numbers means 'outside this dataset's observed range', NOT 'clinically incorrect'. Do not use in front of a patient until reviewed. See docs/VALIDATION_TODO.md. Only `squat` carries real values (legacy config.py).
